groupings.title: Repository Engineering
groupings.description: Answer one question about a repository with a map, an explanation, an app verifier, a test, a measurement, updated docs, or a safe refactor.

groupings.title: Phased Delivery
groupings.description: Turn a chosen direction into a dependency-ordered plan, or deliver an existing plan phase by phase with independent review.

groupings.title: Semantic Algorithms
groupings.description: Run a named reasoning method or a Sem computation you can inspect. These skills are meant to run only when you invoke them by name.

groupings.title: Distribution Administration
groupings.description: Audit, adopt, or repair installed copies of this pack. Changes are previewed first, and repair backs up files before writing.
